# .github/workflows/ai-docs-review-command.yml
# -------------------------------------------------
# Security model documentation
# ---------------------------------
# This workflow is triggered by a slash command (`/ai-docs-review`) via the
# `slash-commands.yml` dispatcher.  It runs in the context of the repository
# where the PR is opened, not in the fork.  The workflow uses a GitHub App
# token to perform API calls, which is scoped to the base repository only.
# This ensures that forked PRs cannot abuse the workflow to access
# privileged data or perform destructive actions.

name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      # Pull request number to review
      # Required: false – the dispatcher passes this value; if omitted
      # the workflow will fail gracefully.
      pr:
        description: 'Pull request number to review'
        required: false
      # Repository name (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (unused)'
        required: false
      # Git reference (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused)'
        required: false

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 1. Create a GitHub App token for API access
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@67018539274d69449ef7c02e8e71183d1719ab42
        with:
          # The app ID and private key are stored in the repository secrets
          # and are automatically injected by the action.

      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 2. Validate required inputs
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Validate PR input
        id: validate-pr
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]; then
            echo "pr_missing=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "pr_missing=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 3. Post error comment if validation fails
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Post error comment
        if: steps.validate-pr.outputs.pr_missing == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            ❌ **Error**: Pull request number is missing. Please provide a PR number.

      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 4. Checkout the PR branch (handles forks)
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        if: steps.validate-pr.outputs.pr_missing == 'false'
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          fetch-depth: 0

      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 5. Detect changed files (with pagination)
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Detect changed files
        if: steps.validate-pr.outputs.pr_missing == 'false'
        id: detect-files
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          # Fetch all changed files in the PR, handling pagination
          gh api --paginate "repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files" -q '.[].filename' > files.txt
          # Check if any file is under the docs/ directory
          if grep -qE 'docs/' files.txt; then
            echo "docs_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "docs_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 6. Post start or skip comment based on file changes
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Post start comment
        if: steps.detect-files.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            🚀 **AI Docs Review**: Starting review of documentation changes...

      - name: Post skip comment
        if: steps.detect-files.outputs.docs_changed == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            ⚠️ **AI Docs Review**: No documentation changes detected. Skipping review.

      # ---------------------------------------------
      # 7. Run the Devin action to perform the review
      # ---------------------------------------------
      - name: Run Devin action
        if: steps.detect-files.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          playbook: "!connectordocs-pr-review"
